status: defined before any new test data

rule_text.a: Detected in at least 2 of the 3 validation cohorts (GSE62928, GSE248762, GSE130888).
rule_text.b: Concordant direction with discovery in every cohort where detected.
rule_text.c: Record discovery BH q < 0.05 as a flag only; it is not a hard selection filter.

selection_logic: A gene is included only when rules (a) AND (b) pass; rule (c) is recorded but does not filter.
status_note: This rule-derived panel is defined on 2026-10-11 using existing saved cohort results. It is not preregistered; all v2 scores on these same existing cohorts are post hoc, exploratory, and not validation claims. The status means the panel is fixed before any future new test data.
